title: Apache Commons Lang searches for a supplementary character on a StringBuilder
summary: A last-index search that starts at the end of a StringBuilder misses a supplementary character. The oracle computes the UTF-16 offset of the final matching token.

change.description: Clamp the search origin to the final possible high-surrogate offset.

notes: The adapter and the independent direct driver each construct a StringBuilder. The forty sequences contain at most three tokens. Both a and b, the supplementary character U+2070E, and the absent control z are searched.

The finite JVM grid gives 25 incorrect parent searches and zero after the repair. All 85 absent-character cases and all 120 ordinary single-code-unit cases agree on both artifacts. All five native claims remain open; the strict gap inventory includes StringBuilder.appendCodePoint and Pattern.compile.
